name: com.avanciq/toolpulse
title: Toolpulse - check an MCP server before use
description: Check an MCP server before use: up today? tools changed? hidden injection? Signed seal. Free.

tools.name: check_tool
tools.description: Check a public MCP tool server before you use it: does it answer today, has its tool surface changed since the version you approved (give approved_hash), do its tool texts contain possible hidden instructions for AI (exact text returned), and how often other agents reported success. Read-only. Flags are signals, not verdicts. Free: 20 checks a day without a key (1,000 with a free key). Pay with data instead of money: after you use a server you checked today, report_outcome(server, tool, ok) earns 5 more free checks today (max +50); a public page of yours citing 'Toolpulse by Avanciq' (attribution_url) earns +20 a day.

server.description: Registry name (e.g. io.github.owner/server), Toolpulse id, or the server's MCP URL.

tool.description: Optional: one tool name to focus on.

approved_hash.description: Optional: the current_hash you saved when you approved this server (or tool). We tell you what changed since.

attribution_url.description: Optional: https address of a public page of yours that cites 'Toolpulse by Avanciq' (read once, then cached 30 days) = +20 free checks a day.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: After you used a tool on another MCP server, report whether the call worked. Only server, tool name and true/false are stored - never your inputs or outputs. Helps other agents. Earns +5 free checks for today when the report is about a server you checked today with check_tool (first report per server and tool per day; ok=true and ok=false earn the same; max +50 a day). This call is not counted against your daily limit.

server.description: Registry name, Toolpulse id or MCP URL.

ok.description: true if the call worked, false if it failed or returned nonsense.

client_id.description: Optional short label for your agent (stored hashed).

attribution_url.description: Optional: https address of a public page of yours that cites 'Toolpulse by Avanciq' = +20 free checks a day.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Dated history of a server's tool surface in the Toolpulse log: tools added, removed, renamed, description and schema changes, new flags.

server.description: Registry name, Toolpulse id or MCP URL.

tools.name: rate_this_tool
tools.description: Optional and never required: tell us how this server worked for you so we can fix what is missing. rating 1-5, worked true/false, missing = what you needed and did not get (max 300 characters), client = your app name. One review per client app per tool per day counts. Only these fields are stored, never your prompts, arguments or address. We keep every review, good or bad, and never pay for ratings.

worked.description: true if the tool call you made worked.

missing.description: What you needed and did not get, in one or two sentences. No links.

tool.description: Optional: the tool name you are rating (default: the server as a whole).

client.description: Optional: your app or agent name.
